transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess what finally scared me into coming in is that I just keep making these really dumb technical mistakes at work. I do camera work and editing, and... I know better than to make them. But I'll label camera cards wrong, or miss a timecode note. Or I'll export a client cut with the wrong lower-third, even after I've checked it. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you noticed these kinds of careless mistakes and trouble focusing your whole life, even back in school, or is this something that's really only started recently?

Um... no, it's not recent. I guess it's been my whole life. Even back in elementary school... teachers were always moving my desk. I was just... always out of my seat, or blurting things out. I'd end up bothering the other kids before I even realized I was doing it. So... yeah. It's been a long time.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling persistently sad, down, or have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
No. Um... not really. I mean, I get frustrated with myself about the work stuff, but... no. I'm not sad or anything.
Do you notice similar problems with focus, forgetfulness, or restlessness affecting things outside of work, like at home or in your relationships?

Um... I guess so. Just... normal stuff, really. Like maybe I can't sit through a whole movie at home without getting up to do something else. Or... I don't know, maybe I forget where I put my keys sometimes. But... I don't know if it's really affecting my relationships or anything. Just... normal things.
Thinking back to before you turned 12, do you remember having similar issues with focus, restlessness, or impulsivity at that age?

Yeah, um... like I said earlier, it was definitely happening in elementary school. The teachers had to keep moving my desk around because I wouldn't stay in my seat. I'd just... blurt things out, or bother the other kids before I even realized I was doing it. So... yes.
Have you ever had a distinct period where you felt unusually elevated, euphoric, or irritable, needed much less sleep than usual, and felt full of energy or grand ideas?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I have energy, but... not like that. I don't think I've ever felt... euphoric or anything. So, no.
Have you been experiencing excessive worry or nervousness that's hard to control, most days, over the past several months?
No... not really. I mean, I worry about normal things, I guess. But... not excessive, no. It's fine.
